Where the waves crash against the rocky shore,
It sings a low, rhythmic lullaby.

Stones lie buried in the sand beneath feet,
Waiting for the tide to rise again soon.
The wind whispers secrets across the water's surface,
While currents dance with an endless grace.

We walk on these vast and unending seas,
Where time seems far away when we are there.
From childhood memories that never truly end,
There is no place where life can be found.

Though storms rage in the night along the shore,
And waves tear through to break the fragile ground,
The sea remains a silent guardian friend,
Who holds the balance of all our days.

It cleanses the lungs from dust and leaves behind,
A memory we cannot forget nor erase.
Even when it turns into salt and ice,
We find no end in its endless embrace.
